name: Unix
description: Event time in whole nanoseconds since the epoch.

name: UnixPartition
description: Hour boundary of `unix` in whole epoch seconds.

name: MarketEventType
description: Packed rekep event-kind code.

name: CreaUnix
description: Creation time in whole nanoseconds since the epoch.

name: RecUnix
description: Recording time in whole nanoseconds since the epoch.

name: ExpUnix
description: Expiry time in whole nanoseconds since the epoch.

name: SnapUnix
description: Source event time for a snapshot in whole epoch nanoseconds.

name: Hash
description: Time-anchored composition of `unix` and `vhash`.

name: VHash
description: Clock-free XXH3-64 value digest.

name: XHash
description: Direct XXH3-128 digest of the UTF-8 `code`.

name: PrevHash
description: Hash of the preceding lifecycle version.

name: PrevUnix
description: Event time of the preceding lifecycle version.

name: ParentHash
description: Ordered hashes of source events.

name: LinkHashes
description: Ordered exact hashes of related events.

name: Version
description: Zero-based lifecycle version number.

name: State
description: Packed ranked lifecycle state.

name: Code
description: Readable lifecycle identifier.

name: AltIDs
description: Other identifiers keyed by scheme or lifecycle field.

name: Reason
description: Reason the event was rejected or could not be interpreted.

name: SymbolTicker
description: Canonical instrument spelling.

name: Unmap
description: Payload entries the registry did not resolve; null when all resolved.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Numeric identity written or resolved; zero while unresolved.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Whole field spelling outside an indexed container.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Text after the first equals sign; an empty value is empty text.

name: PxUnit
description: Unit in which `lastpx` is expressed.

name: QtyUnit
description: Unit in which `lastqty` is expressed.

name: Notional
description: Producer-computed `lastpx * lastqty * multiplier`.

name: MarketMarker
description: Whether the source marks the row as market activity.

name: GlobalOrderId
description: Order identifier shared across source systems.

name: CreationTime
description: Lifecycle creation timestamp expressed in UTC.

name: Env
description: Source environment name.

name: RootOrderId
description: Identifier of the root order in the lifecycle.

name: RootOriginatorOrderId
description: Originator identifier of the root order.

name: OrderFlags
description: Source flags attached to the order.

name: OrderOriginatorId
description: Identifier of the order's originating participant.

name: ConversationId
description: Identifier shared by messages in one conversation.

name: BloombergCode
description: Bloomberg identifier supplied by the source bridge.
